title: Payoff, Refund and Title Release Timetable — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail
content:
**Payoff and title timetable — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

The periods below apply to payoff quotes, overpayment refunds and lien releases on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract. They are the same on every tier, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3, Tier 2, Tier 1 and Tier 1+.

| Item | Figure, all tiers |
|---|---|
| Quote validity period: calendar days after the quote date through which a payoff quote is honoured | 10 calendar days |
| Credit balance at or above which a refund is issued automatically | $1.00 |
| Calendar days within which an automatic overpayment refund is mailed | 30 calendar days |
| Hold after a payoff by personal check or ACH before the lien may be released | 10 business days |
| Business days within which an electronic lien is released once release is permissible | 3 business days |
| Business days within which a paper title is mailed once release is permissible | 10 business days |

### Notes

- The quote validity period is counted in calendar days after the quote date: a quote dated on a given day is honoured through the tenth calendar day after it.
- The lien and title periods are counted in business days, Monday through Friday excluding US federal holidays.
- A credit balance of exactly $1.00 is at the automatic-refund threshold; a balance of $0.99 is below it.
